authorities.discount: ITAA 1997 s 83A-25(1) with s 83A-315: market value when acquired (for an unlisted right, the regulations' value where chosen) less the consideration
authorities.start_up_discounts: ITAA 1997 s 83A-33: the start-up concession reduces the amount included for the interest to nil
authorities.upfront_eligible_discounts: Question 12 label D: discounts in the year's acquisitions taxed upfront that meet ss 83A-35(6), (7) and 83A-45
authorities.deferred_amounts: ITAA 1997 s 83A-110(1): market value at the deferred taxing point (ss 83A-115, 83A-120) less the cost base, for taxing points in the year; question 12 label F
authorities.reduction: ITAA 1997 s 83A-35(1) and (2): label D, at most $1,000, where taxable income, reportable fringe benefits, reportable super contributions and total net investment loss total $180,000 or less
authorities.assessable_discount: Question 12 label B: labels D, E and F less the reduction

rules: ITAA 1997 s 83A-310: Division 83A (but Subdivision 83A-E) is taken never to have applied where an amount was included and the interest is forfeited, or a right lost without disposal or exercise, not by a choice other than to cease employment or (for a right) to let it lapse or be cancelled, nor by a condition protecting against a fall in market value; the earlier assessment may be amended
ITAA 1997 s 83A-33: the start-up concession reduces the amount included for the interest to nil
ITAA 1997 s 83A-25(1): the discount is included in the income year of acquisition; Subdivision 83A-C does not apply (s 83A-105(1))
ITAA 1997 s 83A-20(1): not acquired at a discount
